source.title: Trends in Invasive Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Infections

semantic_spot_checks.claim: CA incidence among children older than 3 months increased 10.2% per year, 95% CI 2.7 to 18.3, P=.007.
Estimated 2010 overall national incidence was 2.6 per 100,000 and estimated infections were 1,895.
The study states that representativeness of the 9 metropolitan surveillance areas for national incidence is unknown.
Hospital-onset case fatality was 14.4%, compared with 2.0% HACO and 1.7% CA.

source_integrity_notes: The abstract prints the CA trend confidence interval upper bound as 18.2%, while Figure 2 and the main Results text use 18.3%. The atom uses 18.3% and preserves this source discrepancy here rather than silently harmonizing it.
The authors suggest that NICU infection-prevention progress likely contributed to the infant hospital-onset decline, but this surveillance design did not directly test that causal mechanism.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer is recorded in atom provenance. Packet verification status is recorded separately by the repair audit.
